create_RpcMethodHandler: create an RpcMethodHandler namedtuple with streaming flags and serializers for a gRPC method
build_DictionaryGenericHandler: build a DictionaryGenericHandler that maps fully qualified method names to their RpcMethodHandlers
test_DictionaryGenericHandler_service: test the DictionaryGenericHandler service method to resolve a handler by call details
review_ChannelReadyFuture: review the _ChannelReadyFuture class that blocks until a gRPC channel reaches READY connectivity
run_channel_ready_future: run channel_ready_future to create and start a future that resolves when a gRPC channel is ready
